title: [FIXED] Opening TextEdit Context Menu may crash if sub menus are freed
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.4.rc3

### System information

Godot v4.4.rc3 - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.11029.1008) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 threads)

### Issue description

When using a TextEdit there is an option to open a PopumMenu (ContextMenu) when right clicking.
When doing so there's a small chance my game will close with no error in the debuger.

Here's the error i get in the Godot.cmd version
